name: hukuhaka-engineering-plan
description: Resolve engineering contracts, dependencies, and uncertainty with repository-grounded plans, then resume authorized implementation.

interface.shortDescription: Plan changes around existing responsibilities and contracts.
interface.longDescription: Ground engineering decisions in existing responsibilities and contracts, explain material changes and dependencies, and choose verification for the required behavior. Planning-only requests end with a plan; implementation requests return to execution.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $engineering-plan to develop a repository-grounded plan for this change.
